buys.item: Chai from the stall at the Lodhi Road gate

answer.says: It is the overcast, Sunil. The light is diffused, which makes the shadows of the domes less distinct but the air more bearable. Thank you.
answer.thought: The overcast softens the violence of the sun, allowing the forms of the tombs to appear without the glare that usually obscures their details. I drink the chai, which is strong and sweet, a necessary grounding against the abstract contemplation of the morning.
